title: Why Did They Fail At the Final Crisis?

entries.value: Their people were too deeply divided
The gods cursed them to ruin
They were vastly overconfident in their plans
Their neighbours conspired to help ruin them
It was actually two crises, and it was too much
They were culturally exhausted and apathetic
Some tried to take advantage of the crisis themselves
Their strengths were useless against this particular problem
The crisis was far too vast and overwhelming
Some of their leaders were allied with the crisis
